state.invariant: Immutable both-proof-verified candidate and preparation; complete protection proofs precede accepted exact swap. Preparation can reject/fence; accepted swap completes forward. Exact account, old/replacement identities and actor/proof provenance retained without bearer tokens.

code_behavior.accept: IdentityRecovery.Accept(operation, intent, ImmutableContentRef? protectionProofs) raises IdentityRecoveryAccepted when the stage is Prepared and the intent equals the frozen intent. A null protectionProofs is accepted and stored as SourceProofs null. The only production caller (AcceptProtectedIdentityRecoveryHandler) always passes the non-null ProtectionProofs of a command whose protection of both identity slots it already verified.
code_behavior.complete_reject: Complete(completionProofs) and Reject(conflictProof) likewise take a nullable ref and accept null; their commands carry non-null refs.
code_behavior.materialize: Materialize(operation, intent, ImmutableContentRef? sourceProofs) accepts null sourceProofs; the handler passes the verified source's non-null RequiredFacts.
code_behavior.tests: Owner tests call Accept, Complete and Materialize with null proofs and assert success and the Accepted/Completed/Prepared events; one test asserts the Accepted fact carries the supplied protection ref.

accept_null_proofs.instructions: For `state.code_behavior.accept`, which handling of a null protectionProofs is consistent with `state.invariant` (complete protection proofs precede accepted swap)?

criteria.refuse_null_in_aggregate: The owner must refuse or be unable to receive an acceptance without a protection proof reference, so an accepted fact always carries one.
criteria.allow_null_receiver_verifies: Allowing null is fine because the receiver handler verifies protection before calling the owner.

null_proof_premise.instructions: Per `state.invariant`, an Accepted fact recorded with no protection proof reference would violate the stated rule that complete protection proofs precede the accepted swap.

criteria.false: It would not violate the rule.

tests_assert_behavior.instructions: The tests in `state.code_behavior.tests` that pass null proofs to Accept, Complete and Materialize are a faithful check of the invariant.

criteria.false: They exercise paths the invariant forbids.
